t: This is the home of CoppaFeel!, a London-based breast cancer awareness charity. It encourages young people to check their chests regularly, so that cancer is caught early. The charity was founded by Kristin Hallenga, a British columnist and philanthropist. She was diagnosed with breast cancer in 2009, at the age of 23, and became an activist for raising awareness among young people. She lived from 1985 to 2024, and the charity she started carries on her work.
